expected.raw_text: AI evaluation standards covering failure modes, bias, drift, hallucinations

parsed.notes:
Read 'What Sets You Apart' literally as a qualifications heading without an explicit optional marker; its items default to required. 'Preference' applies only to the fields-of-study bullet.
Fields of study are not treated as candidate technical skills.
Technologies and practices appearing only in The Opportunity or Responsibilities are excluded.
Failure modes, bias, and drift are dimensions of the explicitly requested AI evaluation practice, not separately named technical techniques.
Hallucination evaluation is mapped to hallucination-detection, flagged because detection is not explicitly named.
